hero.title: Fengming Liu
hero.subtitle: MA Public Policy (Certificate in Research Methods)
hero.institution: University of Chicago · Harris School of Public Policy
hero.bio: I am a MACRM student at the Harris School of Public Policy, University of Chicago (Harris Merit Scholarship), and previously studied Philosophy, Politics and Economics at University College London. I study how language models change the diversity of public and political expression, and when text-as-data measures can be trusted to tell us. Behind that is an older interest in how the systems that carry public discourse shape what people value. I work as a research assistant at the Knowledge Lab and with Dr. Handi Li at UCL, and co-founded Qualitati with Dr. Shubin Yu (HEC Paris).
hero.mimitalk_desc: An AI-powered platform for qualitative research at scale: AI-moderated interviews, focus groups, and conversational surveys, with an automated thematic-analysis pipeline. Co-founded as part of the Generative AI for Research Initiative.
